stitch_shortlist.author: @foxnews
stitch_shortlist.claim: Young people are skipping sunscreen to chase tans — derms warn

pitch.the_claim: News segment: young people are ditching sunscreen and tanning on purpose, and dermatologists are sounding the alarm.
pitch.why_it_stitches: 2.3M views and 11K comments (a live debate); her exact expertise as a Mohs surgeon; a news peg on a dangerous, spreading trend.
pitch.your_fit: She's covered this HARD — her anti-tanning PSA hit 10.2M ('tanning means UVA damage'). A repeat needs a NEW angle: react to the news framing + what she removes in the OR, not the PSA again.
angles: 'you want me to WHAT?': react as the surgeon who cuts skin cancer out
empathy-first: the tan fades, the Mohs scar doesn't — show the real cost
switch-don't-quit: want the glow? here's a self-tanner that won't send you to me

pitch.the_claim: 'Not anti-Botox — I'm 36 seeing how far great skincare gets me without it.' Light @anua brand tag (reads lifestyle, not a hard ad).
pitch.why_it_stitches: 2.5M views on a half-right claim that's tailor-made for a nuanced derm take rather than a dunk.
pitch.your_fit: Corpus-aligned: she says NO to *preventative* Botox ('you should not be getting preventative cosmetic Botox') — but 'nothing is as potent or effective as Botox' for existing dynamic lines. A clean yes-and.
angles: 'yes, and —': skincare delays it, Botox erases dynamic lines; here's the line
she's right about ONE thing: preventative Botox at 25 isn't necessary
what skincare CAN do at 36: retinoid + SPF + peptides, ranked

pitch.the_claim: 'Skin cancer rose as sunscreen sales rose — oxybenzone is the culprit.' Classic correlation-as-causation.
pitch.why_it_stitches: Rides the live summer-2026 sunscreen-misinformation wave (AFP fact-check; Seattle derms pushing back). A dangerous, spreading myth — her single best debunk lane as a skin cancer surgeon.
pitch.your_fit: Corpus-solid: 'it is essential that you use sunscreen to protect from UV damage.' The rise tracks sun exposure + misuse, not sunscreen; she can add the US-vs-Europe filter nuance she's already covered.
angles: debunk the correlation–causation trap in 15 seconds
what actually drives skin cancer rates — from someone who cuts it out
switch-don't-quit: hate the white cast? here's an elegant mineral SPF
